visual_action: The video displays a screenshot of a tweet from 'FactPost'. The tweet announces that 'Emily Gregory wins the Florida HD-87 special election, beating a Trump-endorsed Republican in Trump's home district.' The tweet includes a photo of Emily Gregory and a photo of the Florida state flag. An overlay caption at the top of the screen reads, 'democrats just flipped trump's home district 😥'. The video briefly zooms in on Emily Gregory's photo, then cuts to a photo of Donald Trump wearing a 'MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN' hat, with the same tweet superimposed over his chest.
